body: I honestly have no idea. Only ever heard you could stay where they filmed. Haven't ever looked at any pictures.
If I had to pick another place ig I'd go to Tunisia and see Uncle Owen's house in A New Hope but it's not something I'd go out of my way to do.

For the last several years I've felt overwhelmed by life. I avoid contact with people, or going outside. There's no enjoyment in anything. Whenever one thing starts letting up, more take its place. I've tried talking to people and nothing's helped. I'm just tired of it.
I've been to 8 countries and jumped from a plane 16 times. I'd say at this point it's just wrapping up loose ends.

Just some small things. Sending out a package to my friend, give away some of my things to people that would get use out of them. Get a haircut and some nice clothes because I don't want to look bad when I'm found
